description: Bridge pairing v1 (docs/desktop-extension-plan.md §8.2.1). Keys are P-256: priv = 32-byte scalar, pub = 65-byte uncompressed point. sharedSecret = ECDH x-coordinate. okm = HKDF-SHA256(sharedSecret, salt = extPub||deskPub, info = "qasa-bridge-v1", 36). key = okm[0..32]; code = u32be(okm[32..36]) % 1000000, 6 digits. aesGcm.ciphertext = ciphertext || 16-byte tag, aad = UTF-8 clientId.
